source_title: Travis Kelce vs Patrick Mahomes: Who gives more to charity and community work?
source_excerpt: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce have built extraordinary careers in Kansas City, winning championships and earning millions along the way. But their influence extends well beyond the football field. Both Chiefs superstars have invested heavily in charitable causes, supported children from disadvantaged backgrounds and helped strengthen their communities through their respective foundations. From Kelce's nearly $2 million contribution to Operation Breakthrough to Mahomes' multimillion-dollar grants for youth organisations, their generosity has become an important part of their legacies. While their approaches differ, their shared commitment raises an interesting question: Which Chiefs star has made a bigger impact through charity?Travis Kelce's charity work focuses on education and opportunities for underserved childrenKelce's charitable journey began with a personal connection to the struggles faced by young people. Growing up in Cleveland Heights, Ohio, the tight end saw how access to resources and opportunities could shape a child's future. That experience inspired him to establish the Eighty-Seven & Running Foundation in 2015.The organisation aims to help disadvantaged young people develop skills through education, business, athletics, science, technology, engineering, mathematics and the arts. Rather than limiting its work to financial assistance, Kelce's foundation focuses on giving children the tools to build independent futures.One of his most significant commitments has been his partnership with Operation Breakthrough, a Kansas City nonprofit that supports children and families experiencing poverty. Kelce has contributed nearly $2 million to the organisation over the years through personal donations and directed funds, according to the Kansas City Chiefs.His most ambitious project with the organisation is the Ignition Lab. In 2020, Kelce announced plans to purchase an old building in Kansas City and transform it into a learning and workforce development centre for teenagers. The project became a reality in 2021, providing students aged 14 to 18 with opportunities to explore careers in engineering, automotive work, coding, digital media and entrepreneurship.The centre has helped more than 1,000 students since opening. Its purpose goes beyond classroom lessons, allowing teenagers to gain practical experience and discover possible career paths before entering adulthood.Kelce has also supported his hometown through the Heights Schools Foundation. His contributions have helped more than 2,300 children access remote learning, after-school programmes, tutoring and inspirational speakers.His generosity became particularly visible following the February 2024 Kansas City parade shooting. Two young sisters from the Reyes family suffered gunshot wounds during the incident. Kelce's Eighty-Seven & Running Foundation made two separate $50,000 donations to their family's fundraiser, bringing the total contribution to $100,000. The money helped cover their medical recovery and future needs.He has continued supporting Operation Breakthrough through annual fundraising events. His Celebrity Challenge brings together athletes from Kansas City's professional sports teams to raise money for the nonprofit. In October 2026, the event returned for its seventh edition.Kelce has also won Nationwide's Charity Challenge three times. His latest victory in January 2026 secured another $35,000 donation for Operation Breakthrough. He previously earned the same award in 2020 and 2025, making him the first three-time winner of the programme.Patrick Mahomes' foundation has distributed millions to children's charitiesWhile Kelce has built a strong connection with a few major organisations, Mahomes has developed a wider charitable network through his 15 and the Mahomies Foundation.Established in 2019, the foundation focuses on improving children's lives through health, education, wellness and community support. Patrick and his wife, Brittany Mahomes, have backed several projects across Kansas City and Texas, with grants reaching schools, youth organisations and community programmes.One of their biggest contributions came in 2021, when the foundation donated $1 million towards the redevelopment of Martin Luther King Jr. Park in Kansas City. The funding helped create an inclusive playground where children with different physical and mental abilities could play together.The project became an important community space, with accessible equipment and features designed to welcome children of all abilities. Mahomes also attended the opening ceremony, celebrating the playground with local families.In October 2023, the foundation announced another major commitment. It pledged $1.625 million to Boys & Girls Clubs of America through a multi-year partnership. The contribution supports children in Greater Kansas City, Lubbock, Tyler and Whitehouse, Texas.The partnership also introduced an additional fundraising element. The foundation committed to donating $1,500 for every regular-season touchdown scored by Mahomes, creating another way to connect his NFL performances with youth development.His foundation has also supported food security and children's healthcare. In 2022, it distributed more than 15,000 meals through food bank partnerships and worked with OneSight Vision Clinic to provide free eye examinations and glasses to more than 100 children in the Kansas City area.Mahomes has also supported the Make-A-Wish Foundation, granting wishes to 10 children with serious illnesses. His involvement included spending time with young fans and helping create memorable experiences for their families.Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce support different causes through their foundationsTheir charitable work shares a common goal, but the way they approach it reveals two different priorities.Kelce has built much of his philanthropic identity around long-term involvement. His relationship with Operation Breakthrough goes beyond writing cheques. He regularly visits the organisation, spends time with students and helps create programmes that can support children as they grow older.His foundation also supports educational opportunities in Cleveland Heights and Kansas City. The University of Cincinnati has benefited from his support through a health and wellness endowment for student-athletes.Mahomes, meanwhile, has developed a grant-based approach that reaches a wider network of organisations. His foundation has supported groups such as Lead to Read, City Year, United Way of Greater Kansas City, Children's Mercy Hospital, Special Olympics Missouri and Kansas City Public Library.The foundation's 2024 financial records provide an idea of its reach. According to nonprofit financial data, 15 and the Mahomies distributed approximately $4.6 million through 119 grants between 2020 and 2024. Its 2024 grants included $650,000 for Boys & Girls Clubs of America, $57,500 for City Year, $50,500 for Lead to Read and $50,000 for United Way of Greater Kansas City.Mahomes has also encouraged young people to become active in their communities through programmes such as Read for 15 and Volunteer for 15. These initiatives encourage children to spend time reading and helping others rather than focusing only on receiving financial assistance.The foundation has supported scholarship programmes, food assistance and inclusive sports opportunities as well. Its work with Special Olympics Missouri and other youth organisations reflects a broader effort to reach children with different needs.Who has made a bigger charitable impact, Travis Kelce or Patrick Mahomes?Comparing the two Chiefs stars through a single donation figure would miss much of the story. Their foundations operate differently, and their financial records cover different periods.Kelce has contributed nearly $2 million to Operation Breakthrough alone, while his work with Ignition Lab has created lasting educational and career opportunities for teenagers. His $100,000 contribution to the Reyes family and repeated fundraising victories also demonstrate his willingness to support families facing difficult circumstances.Mahomes has a wider documented grant portfolio. His foundation distributed approximately $4.6 million across 119 grants between 2020 and 2024, alongside major commitments such as the $1 million playground project and the $1.625 million Boys & Girls Clubs partnership.However, the foundation's grant totals should not be treated as Mahomes' personal donations. They include money raised and distributed through the charitable organisation and its partners. The same distinction applies to Kelce's foundation contributions.What stands out is how both players have turned their success into opportunities for others. Kelce has developed a close connection with young people through education and career development, while Mahomes has used his foundation to support a wider range of organisations.Their approaches may be different, but their impact reaches beyond football.
